tools.name: find_leagues
tools.description: List covered leagues and cups with their ids. Optionally filter by a name or country fragment (e.g. "premier", "spain", "champions"). Use the id with the other tools.

tools.name: find_teams
tools.description: Search teams by name (e.g. "arsenal", "real madrid"). Returns team ids, country and main league id for the other tools.

tools.name: find_players
tools.description: Search players by name (e.g. "saka", "haaland"). Returns player ids, position, team id and the slug used by get_player.

tools.name: get_matches
tools.description: Fixtures and results for one day, optionally for one league or only live/finished/upcoming matches. Status is one of Scheduled, LIVE, HT, FT, AET, PENS, Postponed, Cancelled, Suspended.

tools.name: get_live_matches
tools.description: Matches being played right now with the current score and minute. Scores refresh every minute.

tools.name: get_match
tools.description: One match: teams, score, venue, coaches and events (goals, cards, substitutions). Optionally team statistics and lineups (each adds one request). Lineups and stats exist only for competitions covered in detail.

tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: Current league table with points, goals and form (last 6 matches, oldest first). Cups without a table return nothing.

tools.name: get_league
tools.description: A league with its teams (ids), upcoming fixtures and recent results.

tools.name: get_top_players
tools.description: Top scorers, assist leaders or most-carded players of a league this season.

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: A team by id or slug (e.g. "arsenal") with recent and upcoming matches. Optionally the squad (player slugs) and trophies (each adds one request; the slug form already includes the squad).

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Player profile by slug (e.g. "bukayo-saka"): position, nationality, season stats, recent matches and next match.

tools.name: get_player_match_stats
tools.description: Per-match statistics and totals for a player, found by name and team id.
